description: Draft one or more posts into a ProductClank content space. FREE. Call get_content_workspace FIRST and write in that brand's voice, post types and topics — the drafts are scored against exactly that voice by the reviewer a moment after they land, and the scores show in get_content_queue. `platform` must be one of the space's platforms (omit it to use the first). Candidates land in the user's 'All Content' queue for approval; nothing is auto-published. Up to 25 per call. This drafts into the user's OWN content pipeline — it is NOT a community content campaign (use create_content_campaign for that). When the posts form a series, pass the series name in `tags` so every post carries it. Tags are the user's labels in the web Queue's tag filter (e.g. a series or campaign week). Read tags_in_use from get_content_queue first and REUSE an existing tag when the posts belong to it; only make a new one for a genuinely new series, and use one clear, human name for it (e.g. "Communities week", not "communities-week-2026-series"). Spelling is matched case-insensitively to the existing tag.

hls_url.description: HLS (.m3u8) transcode of the clip, for inline Farcaster video; same storage rule.

image_url.description: Still image: any public https image URL (ProductClank copies it into its own storage; up to 3 external images per call). For bytes, attach afterwards with attach_content_image.

tags.description: Labels for this one post, added to the call-level tags.

template.description: Content template, e.g. "Build-in-Public" or "Proof Point". Defaults to Build-in-Public.

title.description: Short internal label / topic for the draft.

video_url.description: Short .mp4 clip. Must be an https public URL in ProductClank's Supabase storage (…/storage/v1/object/public/…).

source.description: Who drafted it. Default agent; use skill when an operator's own Claude skill (e.g. /content, /clip) wrote the batch.

space_id.description: Target content space UUID from list_content_spaces.

tags.description: Labels stamped on EVERY candidate in this call — e.g. the series name. Max 20, 40 chars each.

name: write_content_candidates
title: Draft content candidates
